scope: Integrator performed 36 actual browser tasks, 36 complete-program clipboard copies and 24 linked HTTP downloads against the formal six-language prefix artifact. This independent non-author reviewer read all six German full rendered task bodies/code, actual action/download records and selected actual images. Every old-language task body and code block was individually compared byte-for-byte with the immutable previously independently reviewed five-language prefix capture before retaining its semantics. Original Japanese source author does not self-approve Japanese text; the separate prior Japanese reviewer remains explicit. Actual earlier SDK executions and decoded APKG results are reused solely through the refreshed independent German-stage execution audit. No SDK rerun or native Anki import is claimed.
